Affiliate disclosure

Current status · future principles · how to identify promotions

This page explains Reflex Hub's stance on promotion and commercial partnerships. As of the last update (2026-10-28), the site has signed no affiliate or sponsorship deals, and no page contains promotional links.

Candidates under observation (none applied for, none displayed)

The following official affiliate-program pages are in our candidate ledger (partners.json) for evaluation only. No application has been submitted, none has been approved, and none appears on any page; terms will be re-verified before any application, and a candidate's status will not become active until approved:
· ElevenLabs affiliate program (verified 2026-10-28: the public page states 22% recurring commission on payments for the first 12 months of new paid subscriptions, settled via PartnerStack);
· Make affiliate program (verified 2026-10-28: the public page states 35% of subscription payments; the main text says 12 months while one FAQ entry says 24 months — to be verified before applying);
· Writesonic affiliate page (affiliates.writesonic.com — timed out on both visits; terms could not be verified; validity pending manual confirmation).
Note: this site currently has no real-time-communication API content, so the Tencent RTC affiliate program is not a candidate.

1. Current status: no partnerships, no promotional links

· No affiliate or sponsorship agreement has been signed with any vendor, reseller or promotion platform;
· "Official source" and "official site" links are plain outbound links with no promotional parameters and earn no commission;
· The partnership ledger (partners.json) is currently empty — it exists only as a registration structure for future reviewed partnerships.

2. Principles for any future partnership

If promotions or sponsorships are ever introduced, these rules apply:
· Review first, display second: a partner must pass content review with a verification date recorded before appearing anywhere on the site;
· Disclosure next to the content: the commercial relationship (e.g. "Sponsored") will be stated beside the recommendation, never with wording that implies independent endorsement;
· Link separation: affiliate links are recorded and presented separately from official links, never blurring "official source" with "promotional link", and carry rel="sponsored";
· Unchanged independence: model prices and data come only from vendors' public list prices with verification dates; no partnership affects how data is collected or presented;
· Synced disclosure: this page will list every partner, the form of the partnership and its effective date.

3. How to identify promotional content

· Promotional placements carry an explicit "Sponsored" label directly beside the recommended content;
· Official source links (the pricing sources in model profiles) will never be affiliate links;
· If you spot a suspected undisclosed commercial recommendation, please report it via the Issues link below — we will verify and complete the disclosure.

4. Feedback

Questions about commercial-relationship disclosure? Please open an issue at GitHub.
